svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.9.1.3 Occupant Load
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.9 MEANS OF EGRESS
Except for dwelling units, the occupant load
of a floor area or part of it is the number of
persons it is designed for, but not fewer than
Unless it can be shown that the area will be
The occupant load for dwelling units is based
on 2 persons per bedroom or sleeping area
Drawn: a dwelling unit with three bedrooms (left) and an office floor area (right). Figures are illustration only.
